title: Hinged toolbox task suite
goal: Verify that a toolbox lid opens to the approved angle and returns to its approved closed position in one roundtrip execution.

profiles.title: Hinged toolbox v1
profiles.description: The approved historical toolbox profile with an 85 degree open target and the original radian-valued closed position.

scenarios.title: Open and close the toolbox lid
execution_requirements: Execute the opening and closing checks from one continuous roundtrip trace.
Measure lid angle from the authored revolute axis in both required branches.

tasks.title: Open the toolbox lid
tasks.goal: Move the lid to the approved open angle.

criteria.description: The lid reaches 85 degrees within an absolute tolerance of 3 degrees.

failure_diagnostics.description: The measured open angle is outside the approved 82 to 88 degree interval.

evidence_obligations: Preserve the physical and ideal-reference lid-angle traces and the evaluated peak opening angle.

tasks.title: Close the toolbox lid
tasks.goal: Return the lid to the approved closed position.

criteria.description: The lid returns to 0 rad within the user-approved tolerance of plus or minus 0.1 rad.

failure_diagnostics.description: The final lid position differs from the closed position by more than 0.1 rad.

evidence_obligations: Preserve the final physical and ideal-reference lid angles and the return-to-start evaluation.

source_projects.note: The historical program and whole-machine result exist, while the typed targets and tolerances are established by this user-approved suite.

approval.basis: The user approved an 85 degree opening target with a 3 degree absolute tolerance and a 0 rad closing target with the original radian unit and a 0.1 rad absolute tolerance.
